articles.title: Disasters cost $228 billion in housing losses every year
articles.description: Marking the  International Day for Disaster Risk Reduction, the UN chief stressed that “as climate and disaster risks multiply, building safer dwellings is the shared responsibility of governments, developers, engineers and communities”.

articles.title: 12th Arab partnership for disaster risk reduction meeting: From commitments to joint action, an open regional dialogue on risk-informed development and resilience
articles.description: The 12th Arab Partnership for Disaster Risk Reduction Meeting, held in Tunis on 11 October 2026, identified regional priorities for risk understanding, governance, financing, and early warning, emphasizing stakeholder engagement and joint action.

articles.title: Rio de Janeiro strengthens municipal capacity for urban and climate resilience
articles.description: The course centred on Making Cities Resilient 2030 (MCR2030) and introduced participants to its Ten Essentials and its approach to local resilience planning.

articles.title: WIN DRR Awards spotlight women leaders turning global commitments into inclusive, locally-led disaster resilience in Samoa and the Philippines
articles.description: The WIN DRR Leadership Awards 2026 have been granted to Ms Utumapu of Samoa and Ms Hualde of the Philippines, in recognition of their contributions to strengthening inclusive disaster resilience and women’s leadership.

articles.title: Ghana strengthens its disaster resilience with better data
articles.description: Ghana is investing in better disaster data by migrating to the DELTA Resilience Information System, enabling a more comprehensive and coordinated approach to disaster risk reduction by using richer and more accessible data.

articles.title: Resilience starts at home, and travels outwards to transform societies
articles.description: On International Day for Disaster Risk Reduction, SRSG Kamal Kishore reflects on how everyday decisions about our homes shape disaster risk, how public policy can expand people’s capacity to act, and why recovery works best when households shape it.

articles.title: UN calls for greater investment in housing resilience as homes account for 43% of reported disaster losses
articles.description: Global modelling estimates US$228 billion in average annual residential building losses from cyclones, floods, tsunami and earthquakes, while new survey findings reveal critical gaps in household disaster preparedness.

articles.title: Lao PDR launches initiative and competition to make early warnings reach everyone
articles.description: The Government of Lao PDR, supported by the United Nations, NGOs and CSOs, launch an inclusive risk communication initiative and a video competition on the International Day for Disaster Risk Reduction to improve early warnings.

articles.title: National Disaster Management Agency SL
articles.description: It is an Agency established by an Act of Parliament to manage disasters and similar emergencies throughout Sierra Leone.

articles.title: When home is lost: From prevention to durable solutions for disaster displacement
articles.description: This roundtable will bring together policymakers, practitioners, researchers and other stakeholders to explore how disaster risk reduction can help prevent displacement and support durable solutions when displacement occurs.

articles.title: Tokyo workshop charts practical pathways for emerging technologies in disaster risk reduction
articles.description: Governments, tech companies and researchers met in Tokyo to advance practical, responsible use of AI and emerging technologies for DRR and help shape a joint UNDRR–ODET initiative on knowledge, peer exchange, matchmaking and pilots.

articles.title: Strengthening disaster risk governance in South Sudan
articles.description: From 1 to 5 June 2026, stakeholders convened to validate South Sudan’s Revised Disaster Risk Management Policy. The event was organized by UNDRR in collaboration with South Sudan's MHADM, FAO, WFP, and IGAD-ICPAC.
